findings.finding: The reused analog hand cleanup leaves visible source-hand silhouettes and red second-hand fragments in the static dial.
Connected-component decomposition splits some multi-part or neighboring numeral artwork, producing incorrect spacing after element-preserving mapping.
Local glyph shape is preserved better than raster warp, but the current grouping errors prevent production acceptance.
Weekday and day-of-month are detected, removed from the static layer, and rendered dynamically at runtime.
The element-preserving APK was activated as the real watch face and captured for nine test times on the Wear OS emulator.
